correctness.rationale: For the specified noiseless sequential updates the residual is Q_n...Q_0. Write each Q_j as the projection onto a unit generator of e_j^perp; between consecutive generators the overlap modulus is r_j, since the complementary entries of a 2-by-2 unitary change of bases have equal modulus. Thus the product norm is exactly p_n, including r_j=0 or 1. The nth update coefficient is paired with g_n=Q_0...Q_{n-1}e_n; its norm is a_n and all g_n for n≥1 lie on the same line perpendicular to g_0. A unit input with component norms s,t in those orthogonal lines gives absolute sum s+t sum a_n, whose exact maximum is the claimed Euclidean norm (also at m=0). This proves the equivalence with absolute convergence for all inputs; finite-dimensional scalar-coordinate reduction makes unconditional equivalent to absolute convergence. With an effective sequence and divergent sum a_n, a unit input on e_0^perp has ordered convergence but not unconditional convergence. Choosing real angle increments arccos(p_n/p_{n-1}) realizes every indicated positive profile. Multiplying the given factors gives the gamma quotient and a_n~sqrt(a) C_{a,b} n^{-(a+1)/2}; summing or taking its tail gives exactly the constants at a<1, a=1 and a>1. For the logarithmic profile, log r_n^2=-1/n+O(1/(n log n)); a_n~sqrt(b)(log b)^sigma/[n(log n)^sigma], with the stated log-log endpoint coefficient. The rates refer to cumulative a_n (and the same leading divergence of the maximum), not to every input, e.g. e_0. Inspected the archived real planar diagnostic; neither the infinite sums nor the complex case rely on it.

value.rationale: This is the first dimension where a nontrivial rank-one residual can persist after the first update. The exact norm isolates absolute reconstruction cost from ordered convergence in that natural setting; it tests unconditionality directly from observed adjacent overlaps or a realizable residual profile. The sharp logarithmic scale distinguishes sequences with the same nominal polynomial residual decay and produces quantitative conditional examples rather than merely invoking a textbook convergence test. No noise stability or higher-dimensional generalization is claimed.
